game_title: F-String Herald – Cloud Sea Overlook Defense
game_concept: A tower defense set in Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook, an overlook above the clouds: the avalanche scout must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – F-String Herald: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook: an overlook above the clouds
core_gameplay_loop: In Cloud Sea Overlook, repeat each round: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements. Each round, yetis strike the pass gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the announcements value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the pass gate from yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook: keep the announcements meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: announcements drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 3 (intro tier): F-String Herald
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'F-String Herald' (Week 8 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cloud Sea Overlook'. region.name: Frost Peaks

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how announcements changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 36 seconds while announcements > 0.
